explanation: The upstream 9.1.1 unittest adapter emits each subtest as a call report with its parent nodeid. JUnit increments passed statistics for every successful call report, while reusing one XML node per parent nodeid/worker. The suite attribute therefore counts parent outcomes plus 154 nested successful outcomes; it is not 341 independently collected cases.

limitations: The runtime did not save a separate raw event stream for every successful subtest. 154 is a source-based reconstruction consistent with XML and completed parents.
The installed pytest module bytes were not separately archived; the published 9.1.1 source was inspected after matching the recorded installed version.
